title: Mathrubhumi: India's Financial Fraud Risk Indicator credited with saving Rs 5,403 crore
date_note: Mathrubhumi's publication day; the page gives no earlier day for the figure.
geo_basis: country as the article states it
summary: Mathrubhumi reports that the Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI), a system built on the Department of Telecommunications' digital intelligence platform, has saved Rs 5,403 crore. It says the system alerts banks and other financial institutions when a mobile number may be linked to fraud. The article names no official source for the figure.
plain: Mathrubhumi reports that India's fraud-warning system FRI has saved Rs 5,403 crore. It helps financial institutions check whether a mobile number may be linked to fraud.
exec: Mathrubhumi reports that FRI, which alerts financial institutions to risky mobile numbers, has saved Rs 5,403 crore; no official source is named.

validation.note: Single publisher (Mathrubhumi); no official statement read.

review.note: Compared title, date, Rs 5,403 crore figure and no-official-source wording against the Mathrubhumi page
